name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: @youngstockuser 网络这块确实容易被算力叙事盖住。博通的打法跟 Arista 不一样，一个卖芯片、一个卖整机加软件，云厂商自研交换系统那条线会一直压着议价，单看端口速度不够，还得看 AI 网络收入到底占多少。
@youngstockuser 交换这层确实容易被低估，博通卖芯片不卖整机，云厂商自己组系统这点很关键。昨收 $345.00，刚好在 20 日均线 $347.15 下面，网络收入能不能兑现还得看后续。

Broadcom at +306% expected profit growth over four years puts it near the top of this list, behind only a few names. That is the expectation, not a result. At $345, below all three moving averages, the market is still asking whether execution keeps up. $AVGO

Trainium going outside AWS in late 2027 says custom-silicon demand is bigger than one cloud. AWS grew 39% to $46B, backlog $578B, and 2027 capex goes higher still. Demand is real. So is the cash-flow pressure, and $AVGO sits right in that tension.

@pequityresearch The 29% figure stands out. Server demand looks broad, but Broadcom's XPU share slipping while other customers have yet to ramp is a timing risk. At $345.00, still below the 20-, 50- and 200-day averages, so caution into the Dec 9 earnings makes sense.
Alphabet 电话会把 TPU 从故事讲成了订单。云收入 307 亿美元，同比翻倍；云积压订单 5610 亿美元，TPU 客户近 100 家，2027 年资本开支还要显著增加。Anthropic 经博通采购 TPU 也被点名了。$AVGO 收 345 美元，跌 1.9%。
The $400M JV itself dates to July, so today's approval is a green light, not a new deal. Panel-level packaging only matters if yields hold at scale. 2028 production is the date to watch. $AVGO
惠誉维持博通 A-、正面展望，理由是现金生成强、杠杆低于上调门槛，同时点名表外融资敞口日趋复杂。据彭博报道，银行计划明年一季度发约 210 亿美元债，把部分贷款转给债市。订单故事不缺钱，接下来看的是钱的代价。$AVGO

Talks, not a done deal yet. Buying the optics stack doesn't automatically win the switch socket. Tomahawk got there on deployments, and that's the harder part to copy. CPO is the pitch, installed base is the proof. $AVGO

@carrioresearch The customer link is what makes this one land. Broadcom named as a major WIN customer ties the optical ramp back to a real buyer, though CW lasers and EML at 2028 still leave a long runway for timing to slip. $AVGO

If TPUs turn into a product Google actually sells instead of only running internally, the read-across for Broadcom is pretty direct: outside TPU demand lands on the same roadmap. Still reported, not confirmed, and the 2027 Oracle timeline is the part to watch. $AVGO
Celestica 在电话会上更新了 CPO 的进展：博通 Tomahawk 6 Davisson 芯片的功能平台已经点亮，正在测试，1.6T 机架级方案和一家超大规模客户合作设计制造，量产爬坡定在 2027 年底。从演示到可制造的系统，关键看接下来测试和良率。$AVGO

@RyanReeves_ That $120B bar has aged fast. It looked like a stretch when it was set, and the FY28 guide now sits well above it. Still a guide, not revenue in the bank. FY28-30 leaves plenty of room for orders to slip.

Incremental margin is the right lens here. It says how much of each extra revenue dollar actually reaches operating profit, and on this table that conversion has stayed high. Scale matters, but only if it converts like this. $AVGO
